messages.subject: Average of three models prediction
parts:
Hi everyone, I need your help. I was following previous conversations about this topic but I am stuck at one point.

I have three models fitted and performing well (mo5, mo20, mo21). I would like to make an average of these models and run 'predict' with this averaged model.

All three models were displaying predictions correctly, when considered independently.

mapdata.m = #a rasterStack object containing the raster for all the transformed covariates.

code:

my_models <- list(mo5,mo20,mo21)
names(my_models) <- c("mo5", "mo20", "mo21")
avgmod  <- fitList(fits=my_models)
prediction_psi_avg <- predict(avgmod, type="state", newdata=mapdata.m, appendData=T)

I keep having this error.

Error in array(x, c(length(x), 1L), if (!is.null(names(x))) list(names(x),  :
  la longitud de 'dimnames' [1] no es igual a la extensión del arreglo

Can anyone tell me how can I fix this?
The models have different nPar but were essentially equal in number of pixels. Is there a way to automatically eliminate NAs if this is creating the issue? could it be a matter of the given name?


Thank you in advance

Antonio
